item.title: Q2 Billings Area Weather: More winter weekend warmth and wind; changes next week
item.description: Montana & Wyoming had much weaker wind on Friday, and despite copious amounts of sun, we weren't quite as warm as we were Thursday. We'll have more wind and a warmer day on Saturday with change ahead.

item.title: Montana Rescue Mission faces civil lawsuit over hiring practices
item.description: The women claim the Montana Rescue Mission knew Nathan Lee Church had a problematic background that would put the organization's clients at risk, but hired him anyway.

item.title: Tribe, federal officials differ over proposed sign revisions at Little Bighorn National Monument
item.description: A dispute has emerged between Northern Cheyenne tribal leaders and the federal government over how history is presented at the Little Bighorn Battlefield National Monument.
